requestCommon.subject_description: Nightshade, a lean adult alien in sunglasses and a leather jacket, with a normal-sized skin-spiked head, visible neck gills, a slender lion-like tail, a thin rear braid-like appendage and a short hook-and-chain.
requestCommon.initial_pose: Standing in the approved relaxed pose with the hook-and-chain held naturally and boots grounded.

standing.prompt: Subtle calm seamless idle loop. Hold the exact approved stance, head direction, sunglasses, hook grip and arm positions steady. Only gentle chest/neck breathing and a tiny relaxed motion at the tip of the slender tail. The forehead and crown points are ONE solid skin/skull shape: keep the crown points completely rigid with the head; no hair movement, windblown spikes, hairline or separate cap. The small rear braid-like appendage barely settles. No large weight shift, head turn, waving, hook gesture, hopping, torso lean or whole-image wobble. Preserve the approved normal adult head, neck gills, slim limbs, thin tail/tuft, clean thick outlines and flat colors. Fixed camera/scale, full body and all appendages within the unchanged transparent canvas.

victory.prompt: Expressive cocky victory celebration LOOP with clear full-body key poses: bend both knees in anticipation, make one jaunty celebratory hop while raising the hook hand triumphantly and flashing a small confident two-finger salute with the free hand, land with flexed knees, briefly lean back with a proud chest-out attitude, then settle into the original standing pose. The slender tail follows the body with a light delayed swing and the small rear braid-like appendage follows gently. The top head spikes remain RIGID skull/skin anatomy, never loose hair or a cap; preserve the continuous forehead. Keep the normal adult head, sunglasses, visible gills, leather jacket, thin tail/tuft and clean chunky flat-shaded pixel style unchanged. Fixed camera and character scale, no sliding, entire head, limbs, hook, chain and tail inside the canvas. Transparent background; no text, confetti, trophy or extra characters.

cast.prompt: Expressive magical star-thief cast: crouch and pull the hook arm back in anticipation, twist the shoulders, sweep/reach the hook outward in a clear arc, then pull it toward the chest/pocket as if stealing a spark. Follow through and return to the starting stance. A narrow VIOLET light trail follows the moving hook tip; small bright GOLD sparkles curl inward to the hand, then fade away. Keep the effect compact and visible, clear of the face/gills. Preserve the approved normal head, sunglasses, jacket, adult proportions, thin tufted tail and narrow rear braid. Crown points are RIGID skin continuous with the forehead, never loose hair or a separate cap. Strong distinct body/limb poses; no sliding or full turn. Fixed camera/scale, whole character and effect inside the transparent 192x192 frame. No scenery, text, numbers or large collectible stars; the game adds the spent-star overlay.
